name: Sensation

images.credit: CamWow, CC BY 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Successor: HTC One X (by range), HTC One S (by size)

Network.Technology: GSM/GPRS/EDGE, 850 900 1800 1900 MHz, UMTS/HSPA, 850 1900 2100 or 900 1700 2100 MHz, HSDPA 14.4 Mbps, HSUPA 5.76 Mbps

Body.Other: USB and Wi-Fi tethering, HTC Sense v3.0 user interface (v3.5 on the XL edition)

Platform.Operating system: Android 2.3.3 Gingerbread with HTC Sense 3.0, Upgradable to 4.0.3 with HTC Sense 3.6 , 7.1.2 with custom ROM
Platform.CPU: Sensation 1.2 GHz dual-core Qualcomm Scorpion, Sensation XE 1.5 GHz dual-core Qualcomm Scorpion

Display.Display: 4.3 in capacitive S-LCD Gorilla glass touch screen with qHD (540×960) resolution at 256.15 PPI

Cameras.Rear camera: 8-megapixel (3264×2448) with autofocus and dual LED flash, 1080p HD (only 720p HD on XL) video recording @ 30 frame/s with tap-to-focus and digital zoom (sensor: 1/3.2" Samsung S5K3H1GX)

Battery.Battery: Sensation 1520 mAh internal rechargeable li-ion, removable , Sensation XE 1730 mAh

Connectivity.Connectivity: 3.5 mm TRRS jack, Bluetooth 3.0 with A2DP, FM stereo receiver (87.5-108 MHz) with RDS, Micro USB 2.0 (5-pin) port with Mobile High-definition Link (MHL) for USB or HDMI connection, Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n
